symptom: Representative VII pages emitted browser or React code errors during normal rendering, especially when a place gallery contained repeated supplier image URLs and when a stored map snapshot was not yet available.
expected_behavior: Pages render without uncaught browser errors, React identity warnings or expected-fallback HTTP errors while preserving truthful gallery membership, ordering, map fallback and controls.
environment: Public VII baseline and the exact cumulative local candidate release/v909-home-cold-render-20261113, desktop and 390px mobile, 2026-11-14.

steps: Open representative vacation, event, spa and hourly place pages.
Open and operate each full gallery, including topic changes, viewer close and desktop/mobile transitions.
Capture console errors, React duplicate-key or hydration warnings, page errors and HTTP responses of status 400 or higher.
Open the home and each world index and detail route on desktop and mobile, then reload a place page.
reproduction.evidence: .qa-output/vii-console-errors/public-before-instrumented/gallery-mobile-release-audit.json captured map-snapshot 404 errors on public spa/hourly pages; source inspection found source-only gallery keys. The exact fixed candidate evidence is in .qa-output/vii-console-errors/local-final-exact/gallery-mobile-release-audit.json and .qa-output/vii-console-errors/local-route-final-exact.json.

observations.observation: GalleryExperience rendered multiple lists with React keys derived only from item.src even though supplier data can intentionally preserve the same source image as distinct place and unit identities.
observations.evidence: Before the fix, app/components/gallery-experience.tsx used URL-only keys in mobile tour and progress lists and desktop progress/grid lists.

observations.observation: Public spa and hourly samples requested absent optional map snapshots and received HTTP 404 before falling back to the venue image.
observations.evidence: .qa-output/vii-console-errors/public-before-instrumented/gallery-mobile-release-audit.json records GET /api/map-snapshot?world=spa&id=spa-6 and world=hourly&id=hourly-475 as 404 browser errors.

hypotheses.mechanism: React list keys used image source alone, but identical supplier URLs can legitimately appear in distinct gallery identities, causing key collisions.
hypotheses.prediction: A gallery with the same image URL in multiple topic scopes emits a duplicate-key warning; a stable composite identity removes the warning without changing item order.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Assert composite category/topic/index/source keys and exercise all four gallery worlds while collecting console and page errors.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed. Composite keys were applied to shared gallery, guest-photo and video lists. The focused regression suite passed 16/16 and the final four-world audit recorded zero runtime errors while all gallery interactions passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: An expected missing optional map snapshot used HTTP 404 as client control flow, which the browser surfaced as an error even though the visual fallback succeeded.
hypotheses.prediction: Spa/hourly pages without a stored snapshot log 404, while a non-error readiness probe can preserve the same fallback without a console error.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the instrumented public baseline with the exact candidate after adding a 204 readiness probe and retaining ordinary image-request semantics.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed. Public baseline captured the two 404s; the exact candidate returned zero runtime errors across those same worlds and the broader route matrix.

hypotheses.mechanism: A general page-rendering or hydration failure is responsible for the reported errors.
hypotheses.prediction: Errors persist across index/detail/reload routes after the two targeted fixes.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run desktop and mobile route reliability checks across home, four world indexes, four detail routes and reload.
hypotheses.result: Rejected for the tested family. Twenty checks returned no captured console, page, hydration, duplicate-key or HTTP failure errors.

hypotheses.mechanism: The observed cross-world console noise had two independent shared-component causes: ambiguous React media identities and an expected optional map fallback represented as HTTP 404.
hypotheses.prediction: Fixing both shared mechanisms removes the errors across their affected worlds without changing gallery order, map fallback or controls.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Apply both narrow fixes, then build and exercise all four detail worlds plus the desktop/mobile route family with runtime error capture.
hypotheses.result: Supported. The exact candidate passed the build, 16 focused tests, four gallery-world interaction audits and 20 route checks with zero captured runtime errors.

fix.change: Use stable composite React keys for legitimate repeated media identities. Probe optional map-snapshot readiness with a 204 status/header contract and transfer the image only when ready; retain the existing venue-image fallback and ordinary image endpoint behavior.
fix.evidence: 16/16 focused tests passed; pnpm build passed; the exact candidate four-world gallery audit passed with zero runtime errors; the exact candidate desktop/mobile route matrix passed 20/20 with zero captured errors.

The route matrix is a representative cross-world family check, not a mathematical proof over every generated URL.
authorization_boundary: Read-only production diagnosis and local source/test changes only; no production publication or data mutation.
